question.text: Change of Sponsor or Manager of a Cat III AIF attracts a fee equivalent to:

answer.text: Rs. 15 lakh (equivalent to Cat III Registration Fee)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per SEBI Circular Nov 17, 2022, such change attracts a fee equivalent to the Cat III Registration Fee, i.e., Rs. 15 lakh. Fee cannot be passed on to investors. **The Trap:** Rs. 5/10/25 lakh is not the prescribed fee. **Cross-Exam Context:** Registration fees differ by category — Cat I is lower. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Ensure the board approving the change includes a resolution that the fee will be borne by the sponsor/manager.
